signature.name: ML-DSA-65
signature.secret_distribution: s1 in R^5 and s2 in R^6; ideal independent uniform coefficients in [-4,4], rejection-sampled from SHAKE256
signature.matrix_distribution: 6 by 5 polynomials, ideal uniform coefficients mod q in NTT form, expanded from rho with SHAKE128
signature.mask_distribution: 5 polynomials with coefficients in [-gamma1+1,gamma1], via ExpandMask
signature.challenge_distribution: 49 nonzero +/-1 coefficients, 207 zero coefficients, SampleInBall from 48-byte c-tilde
signature.source: src/pqdid/bounded_mldsa.py; native pinned ML-DSA-65 params.h; implementation_spec R-009/032/033

proof.name: BC-1 raw-view Boolean MPC-in-the-head
proof.tapes: independent raw uniform g bits per party/repetition
proof.circuit_identity: independent CGen(kind,X), BC-1 with SPEC-003/004; complete equivalence unverified

caps.pre_release: bounded verify every role signature; no retry after exhaustion

implemented.ordinary_backend: liboqs 0.16.0 and liboqs-python 0.16.0, pinned mldsa-native; reference fixture/primitive adapter
implemented.bounded_verification: Implemented separately in Python; all 30 matrix samplers and SampleInBall obey byte caps; no fallback
implemented.bounded_production_signing: not implemented; service interfaces default unsupported
implemented.pre_release_checks: Reference manager/issuer/DID/verifier service paths use bounded verification before commit/release; full production signer integration unimplemented
implemented.holder_secret_generation: binding API validates supplied 32-byte secret; length alone does not establish entropy or secure generation
implemented.nonces: SystemNonces uses secrets.token_bytes(32); injected deterministic sources are test-only; process RNG/VM cloning and erasure assumptions remain
implemented.BC1_proofs: not implemented end to end; foundations and partial signature/message circuitry are evidence only
implemented.auth_relation: relations.auth_private reconstructs one credential and reuses its attributes/rid across CredValid, non-revocation and disclosure; auth adds PubOK and Ppub
implemented.service_proof_adapter: Unsupported by default; test token/reference evaluators are explicitly not cryptographic receipts
implemented.deployment_isolation: safely stopped unactivated; original 22 identity cases pending; authorisation and 250.22-second allowance preserved
